operators.name: custom_adaptive_avg_pool2d_forward

parameters.name: x
parameters.shape: input tensor of shape (N, C, H, W)

returns.shape: output tensor of shape (N, C, output_size_h, output_size_w)

semantics: For each output position (oh, ow), compute average over input region [floor(oh*H/output_size_h), ceil((oh+1)*H/output_size_h)) x [floor(ow*W/output_size_w), ceil((ow+1)*W/output_size_w))
No bias or extra parameters; pure average pooling
Preserves batch and channel dimensions independently
Supports arbitrary strided input by handling non-contiguous tensors or transparently making contiguous if required by kernel implementation
Apply AdaptiveAvgPool2d with output_size=(5,5) to input tensor of shape (16,3,1024,1024)
Each output element is the mean of the corresponding adaptive pooling region
The returned tensor is the same object as the step_001 result
